flags.why: This word belongs mainly to literary or elevated language, rather than ordinary casual speech.
Standalone rầu meaning sad or worried is used mainly in Southern Vietnamese.
The entry omits the everyday verb meaning to draw or suck in, especially one's stomach or cheeks.
flags.fix: Add: verb | to draw in; to suck in (one's stomach or cheeks); example: Anh ấy hóp bụng lại. = He sucked in his stomach.

flags.why: Nghêu is primarily the Southern Vietnamese word for clam.
This sense belongs to formal administrative or legal language.
Vựa in the storehouse or wholesale-depot sense is mainly Southern Vietnamese.
